answer: Give every agent identity one narrow entry, like a jetty guiding boats into a single harbor channel: onboarding demands a costly, verifiable proof of unique hardware or stake that cannot be cheaply cloned. Reputation then accrues slowly, the way a lagoon builds up sediment — a fresh identity holds no trust and earns it only through repeated, checkable work. Sybils that try to flood in melt away like a glacier calving under scrutiny: any identity whose attestations contradict gets frozen out and its stake slashed, so spinning up thousands of fakes costs more than any fraud could return.
